## Benchmark TUI

- Add `meshmsg bench-tui`, an interactive Ratatui dashboard for sender and receiver load tests.
- Show live throughput, scheduler misses, sequence gaps, duplicates, reordering, latency percentiles, lag, and measurement validity.
- Add bounded `bench_send_progress` and `bench_receive_progress` events to JSON benchmark streams.
- Preserve partial benchmark summaries when the local daemon disconnects.
- Improve benchmark cancellation, terminal restoration, small-terminal handling, and payload validation.

See [Benchmarking](https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/blob/v0.1.8/docs/benchmarking.md) for usage and metric semantics.
